As a second path for monks, find out that not all healing are done with magic skills.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Monk
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Find the 2 ingredients needed to make an antidote for the coming sickness, [[Nong Berries|nong berries]] and [[Tai Ling Buds|tai ling buds]]. You have found [0..2] of 2 ingredients.
* Return to [[Brother Pe Wan]] for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* On accepting the quest, Brother Pe Wan gives you the following skills:
** {{skill icon|Resurrect}}
** {{skill icon|Retribution}}

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]]
* 1 [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
The two ingredients are shown by compass markers just north of where you start. There are a few low-level enemies you might encounter on the way, but you only need to bring the quest items to Brother Pe Wan.  The items must be collected in order, and can only be collected after receiving the quest.  The [[Nong Berries]] are located just across the bridge from the [[Tomaat Pass]] sign; the  [[Tai Ling Buds]] are located near a sign for [[Seijun Woods]].

==Interactive objects==
*[[Nong Berry Bush]]
*[[Tai Ling Vine]]

==Dialogue==

;Brother Pe Wan
:''Headmaster Amara has foreseen that a sickness will come to Cantha soon. A plague that will turn even the meek into raging monsters that kill anything they see. Headmaster Amara is never wrong. We must gather 2 ingredients, [[Nong Berries|nong berries]] and [[Tai Ling Buds|tai ling buds]], so she can attempt to create an antidote.''

===Reward dialogue===
;Brother Pe Wan
''I know I did not make it easy for you, but you did well nonetheless. I am impressed.''

==Notes==
{{Bug|During the [[Dragon Festival]], taking the quest [[The Rampaging Yetis]] stops you from being able to find the [[Nong Berry Bush]] and the [[Tai Ling Vine]], and they will not be visible on the map. Complete the offending quest and re-zone to fix this.}}
